description: Use what was read in an earlier turn after the file is gone (tests that history survives between turns).

steps.prompt: What port does config.toml configure? Just answer with the number.
Create notes.md with a two-line description of this folder.
config.toml was deleted by mistake. Recreate it with exactly the settings it had, from what you saw earlier in this conversation.

checks.name: db section restored
checks.run: grep -Eq '^\[db\]' config.toml && grep -Eq '^path *= *"data/ledger.sqlite"' config.toml && grep -Eq '^retries *= *3' config.toml
